cam_setup.shot_size_description: The video begins with a ground-level shot of an animated brown mouse (Jerry) standing in front of a door frame and running into a room through a partially open door. As the mouse slams the door shut, an animated blue cat (Tom)’s head collides with it, creating a large hole. Realistic door fragments burst outward, emphasizing the impact. The collision causes the mouse to bounce slightly upward in the frame before quickly scurrying away. The camera then shifts to focus on the cat’s angry head protruding through the hole in the door.
cam_setup.camera_angle_description: The video begins with a low-angle shot, positioned close to the ground, capturing an animated brown mouse running into a room through a partially open door. As the mouse slams the door shut on an animated blue cat, the cat’s head collides with the door, creating a large hole with realistic door fragments bursting outward. The camera then tilts upward as the action unfolds, tracking the impact. The sequence concludes with a close-up low angle shot, centering on the cat’s head protruding through the hole in the door.
cam_setup.subject_height_description: The camera starts at the height of the mouse (Jerry). As Jerry slams the door on the cat (Tom), the camera shifts focus to Tom, moving slightly upward while remaining just below his head.

cam_motion.complex_motion_description: The camera captures the fight scene between Tom and Jerry. It starts by moving forward, then tilts upward as Jerry shuts the door, freezing at the moment Tom's head hits it.
